notes: «وكان، يكنى أبا هاشم» gives Isma'il's kunya as a description, not a transmitter; left out.
The first branch (إسحاق to إسماعيل) writes no name after إسماعيل; the saying belongs to the second branch after «ح», so the first is not extended.
«أبيه» is a bare relation to «عاصم بن لقيط» (rule 7), kept as a relation link.
